title: At load, a cloud that could not be read over a stale device copy: "Use this browser only" exits onto that old copy with no question
evidence: Left by A28 (US-09 AC49, PR 1603), adversary on 5ac1bdc4. holdsCopyHere (widget-src/standalone/connect.ts) counts any stored device file as a copy, and nothing removes the device file after a connect: liftDeviceCopy (packages/health-core/src/record-transfer.ts) lifts it into the cloud and never deletes it. Failing sequence: a guest enters one value; connects Drive or Dropbox (the lift copies it up, the device file stays); months of edits reach only the cloud; on a later load the sign-in is dead, the page falls back to the old device file; "Use this browser only" asks nothing and exits onto months-old data, forgetting the cloud. The record is intact in the cloud; choosing the same cloud in the picker brings it back. Needs different words from AC49's (this browser does hold a copy, just an old one), so Brad's or the owner's sentence first. Second item: confirmingExit is page-global, so if an edit lands while the question shows (another tab, or the live re-read), its words can go stale: the question says no copy while one now exists. Found 2026-11-13
